result.title: Applied bifidelity material response model construction and uncertainty quantification with a sampling hypernetwork
result.summary: Multifidelity modeling offers a practical route to accurate prediction and uncertainty quantification when high-fidelity data are scarce but lower-fidelity data are comparatively abundant. This work develops a bifidelity Langevin sampling hypernetwork framework that constructs probabilistic neu- ral response models by learning a posterior distribution over model parameters rather than a single deterministic fit. The method combines a flexible shared-latent data representation for low- and high-fidelity responses, enabling parameter sharing and transfer learning between the fidelities. We introduce several methodological enhancements to improve the robustness and efficiency of this ap- proach, including stability-promoting drift models, staged and conditional training strategies, adap- tive initialization of Langevin trajectories, and training procedures designed to better exploit corre- lations between fidelity levels. These additions improve convergence behavior, reduce the sampling effort required to obtain representative posterior ensembles, and provide more reliable predictive uncertainty in data-limited regimes. The resulting framework makes more effective use of available multifidelity data while preserving interpretability through the learned posterior structure, yielding improved predictive performance, better uncertainty characterization, and a more stable workflow for constructing uncertainty-aware surrogate models. The method is demonstrated on experimental, high-fidelity simulation and illustrative synthetic data.

AI.brief_summary: 面向高保真数据稀缺的材料响应建模，提出双保真 Langevin 采样超网络，通过共享隐表示与后验采样构建概率化代理模型，并用漂移建模、分阶段训练和自适应初始化提升收敛与不确定性刻画。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以采样后验代替单一确定性拟合」及跨保真度共享 latent 的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的概率化表征与多源视觉证据融合提供概念参考，但领域距离远，需核查可迁移性。
